technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, we will implement a lazy reparse strategy to remove the modules list from BaseDefinition, ensuring backward compatibility.
For U2, we will use Hadoop's FileSystem API with explicit commit acknowledgments, leveraging existing Spring XD HDFS integration patterns.
For U3, we will extend the module SPI by adding a method to override the default partition function, allowing per-module partition logic.
For U4, we will modify the Kafka consumer configuration to use manual partition assignment, enabling consumption from multiple topic-partitions into a single queue.
For U5, we will develop a new DSL parser using ANTLR or a similar parser generator, with cross-stream reference resolution via a symbol table.
For U6, we will create a design document (Markdown) describing the single-container deployment approach, including module colocation and communication.
For U7, we will implement custom serialization logic to preserve non-default ConversionService tuples across deserialization boundaries.
For U8, we will use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) to benchmark stream performance with and without JMX, and produce a documented comparison.
assumptions: The developer is experienced with Spring XD, Java 17+, and related technologies (Hadoop, Kafka).
All required development and test environments are available, including a Hadoop cluster and Kafka broker for integration testing.
The existing test suite and CI pipeline can be reused with minimal adaptation.
Effort estimates include requirements analysis, design, implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation where applicable.
No unexpected external dependencies or API changes will arise from the implementation of these user stories.
U6 is a pure design and documentation task; no code implementation is required.
U8 involves setting up benchmark scenarios, running them, and documenting results; no production code changes are expected.

activities.activity_name: Experiment with removal of modules list from BaseDefinition
activities.activity_description: Implement a lazy reparse approach to remove the list of modules from BaseDefinition, as per the branch referenced in U1. Involves code refactoring and testing.

activities.activity_name: Reliable HDFS writes for stream pipelines
activities.activity_description: Add support for reliable HDFS writes by implementing acknowledgment of HDFS commits, rather than just message bus acknowledgments. Includes integration with Hadoop FileSystem API.

activities.activity_name: Override partition function within source/processor modules
activities.activity_description: Allow module developers to override the default partition function by extending the module SPI with a new method. Includes design, implementation, and tests.
Enable consuming from multiple Kafka topic-partitions and serving the data via a single queue. Involves modifying consumer configuration and partition assignment logic.

activities.activity_name: New DSL parser for Flo UI
activities.activity_description: Develop a new DSL parser capable of detecting incorrect module/option values when supplied from the Flo UI, with support for cross-stream references. Includes parser implementation using ANTLR and integration with existing parser.

activities.activity_name: Design and document single container deployment approach
activities.activity_description: Create a design document detailing the approach for deploying a stream in a single container, including module colocation, communication, and configuration. No code implementation.
Fix the issue where non-default conversion service tuples are lost after deserialization, by implementing custom serialization logic to preserve them.

activities.activity_name: Benchmark stream with and without JMX
activities.activity_description: Set up benchmarks to compare stream performance with and without JMX enabled, using JMH. Document the differences in performance in a report.
